steps.en: Download the release zip for your platform and unzip it — one binary, no Python or COLMAP
steps.zh: 下载对应平台的发布包解压——一个可执行文件，不装 Python 和 COLMAP

steps.en: Point its built-in SfM at a folder of photos (or video frames)
steps.zh: 把内置 SfM 指向一个照片文件夹（或视频抽帧）

steps.en: Finds and matches features on the GPU, solves every camera pose and a sparse point cloud
steps.zh: 在 GPU 上提特征、做匹配，解出每台相机的位姿和稀疏点云

steps.en: Writes a COLMAP-format dataset the trainer can read directly
steps.zh: 写出训练器能直接读的 COLMAP 格式数据集

steps.en: Start training on that dataset, optionally with a preset such as 360-camera
steps.zh: 在这个数据集上开训，可选 360-camera 等预设

steps.en: Optimizes millions of Gaussians via Vulkan or CUDA, streaming progress to a web viewer
steps.zh: 用 Vulkan 或 CUDA 优化数百万个高斯，并把进度推到网页查看器

component.zh: 训练引擎 + 网页查看器

steps.en: Saves a checkpoint with the trained splat.ply, ready to view, edit or mesh
steps.zh: 保存含 splat.ply 的检查点，可直接查看、编辑或转网格

value.en: A photo or video capture becomes a trained splat on any-vendor GPU without assembling a Python + CUDA + COLMAP toolchain
value.zh: 照片或视频变成训练好的 splat，任意厂商 GPU 都能跑，不用自己拼 Python、CUDA 和 COLMAP

sources: README → intro ('one self-contained binary. No Python/PyTorch, no separate COLMAP install') and Download ('download and unzip'; 'spirula train command will serve a viewer on an HTTP port')
src/sfm/README.md → usage block ('spirula sfm auto IMAGES/ -o WORKSPACE/          # images -> sparse model')
docs/notes/sfm-design.md → D1/D4/D14 (GPU SIFT, COLMAP on-disk interchange, 'sfm auto: one command from images to a COLMAP model')

src/app/README.md → Build & run ('spirula train [<preset>] --data <colmap_dataset_dir>'; presets incl. 360-camera) and Mesh extraction ('<ckpt> = run dir (config.json + step-*.ckpt/) ... or a splat.ply')
